_source: DriveBC HighwayCam 244, Hwy 101 at Egmont Road, 49.745664/-124.001841, looking south. Current image https://www.drivebc.ca/images/244.jpg; 24h of retroactive frames via https://www.drivebc.ca/api/webcams/244/replayTheDay/ then https://www.drivebc.ca/images/replaytheday/244/<timestamp>.jpg. Refreshes every 900s.
_axis: Rows increase toward the camera. The terminal is north, off the bottom of frame; the queue's head is behind the camera and its tail runs away into the distance, so a longer queue has a SMALLER tail row.
_light: A strip of the far carriageway used only to measure the light. Its 90th percentile across the 2026-08-14 replay day tracked the sun (154 at dawn, 233-239 midday, 183 under passing shade) and did not move when the queue arrived: 237/238/238/239 over the four queue frames against 234 and 237 either side of them.
_far_row: The road bends out of sight around row 110 and station spacing falls below one row per vehicle before that. 118 is where the fit is still resolvable.
_near_row: The DriveBC watermark bar occupies rows 254-288, so the near end of the road is occluded. camera_row stays at 288 because the distance model is fitted to the road, not to what is visible of it.
_capacity: Local knowledge, not measured: the vessel usually takes another 10-15 vehicles beyond this camera once the queue has reached it. Note this sits just past max_vehicles (10.3) -- the camera saturates fractionally before the capacity line, so a frame filled to the far row reports a bound rather than a number.
fitted_from: 2026-08-15, from the 2026-08-14 replay day (96 frames). Station model fitted to five consecutive ordinary cars in the 13:00 queue (front bumpers at rows 142/155/170/185/200, RV excluded), rms 0.6px. Flank fitted to the 5th-percentile x of the change blob across the four queue frames 12:45-13:30, median residual 3.3px. Validated over 59 daylight frames referenced against a clear frame within 45 minutes: 4/4 true queues found, 0 false.
